result.freshness_policy: indexed: the projection is caught up by byte offset before every search and on recall/refresh; a shortened file forces a full rebuild

debug_stall_ms.description: Artificial pre-scan delay, for recording the cancellation conformance case. Leave unset in real configuration.

files.description: Stream files, absolute or relative to the location. Empty means the location is the file.

max_candidates.description: Cap on candidates returned by one search.

upstream.description: Maps a record's `system` to the source_id owning those records. Each mapped record emits derived_from '<source_id>:<ref>'; an unmapped system emits no edge.
